_perps: Perps Compounders (since 2026-11-17, user's spec): paper trading on Hyperliquid's public data, 10x isolated, 100% of the bankroll as margin, longs and shorts, no stop-loss, 2h time limit. Conservative $110 +13.93%/day, Aggressive $25 +20%/trade, $5,000 cash-out then a new cycle from the seed. Fees: Hyperliquid base tier (taker 0.045%, maker 0.015%).
_perpsVariants: Since 2026-11-17 (user choice after the 16-day backtest): Conservative stops for the day after its first target sale (dayStop firstTarget, even if earlier trades that day lost), Aggressive has a 4h time limit (maxHoldHours overrides the 2h default).

perps._stopLoss: Since 2026-11-17 (user request): a stop-loss market order at this fraction of the way to the liquidation price, paying the taker fee, half the spread and extraSlipPct; keeps the maintenance margin a liquidation would take (about half the bankroll on coins capped at 10x).

entry._lax: lax true skips every entry filter below (only the universe checks apply and the score ranks the coins). Tried 2026-11-17 at the user's request with a looser universe ($1M volume, $0.5M OI, 0.3% spread); the backtest took both runs under $1, so the user went back to these strict rules the same day.

compounder._enabled: Switched off 2026-11-17 (user request): the spot memecoin Compounders are retired while the system is rebuilt for perp futures.
compounder._restart: Every run started before a restart's `at` (only the listed variants, if `variants` is given) is ended at its last mark and starts again from its seed.

restart.note: restarted 2026-10-20 at the user's request: ZBCN sold at its last mark, 4 test runs replaced by the Conservative and Aggressive Compounders
restarted 2026-10-24 at the user's request: Coca Cola rugged to $0; now buys tokens 72h+ old
restarted 2026-10-27 at the user's request: TROLL (flat 3 days) and Marvin (rugged) closed at their last mark; 6h time limit added
restarted 2026-11-11 at the user's request: no buy since 2026-10-31 on 15-60 min tokens ($5.30); now buys 1-72h tokens like the Conservative Compounder

compounder._variants: Since 2026-10-20 two runs; a variant's `entry` overrides compounder.entry for that run only (since 2026-11-11 both buy pairs 1-72h old; before that the Aggressive one bought 15-60 min). They never hold the same token at the same time; when both are in cash the Conservative Compounder (listed first) picks first. Since 2026-10-21 the runs loop: once a run's bankroll reaches goalUsd + seedUsd ($5,110 / $5,025) it is all cash (a held position is sold as soon as it is worth that, even below its target), at least goalUsd is cashed out, seedUsd is kept, and a new cycle starts from seedUsd at the next hourly run.
compounder._maxHoldHours: Since 2026-10-27 (user request; 6h, then 1h from 2026-10-28): a position that hasn't reached its target this many hours after the fill is sold at the last price before then, and the run searches again. A variant can override it with its own maxHoldHours.
compounder._outcomes: Since 2026-10-28: every token a run evaluates inside its age window (bought or rejected, with the reason) is re-priced this many minutes later (data/candidate-outcomes.jsonl); a token is tracked again only after trackEveryHours.

oneOffExits.note: User request 2026-10-11: close the Fartcoin position bought 2026-10-11 07:00 UTC in every run if no target is hit within 24h of the fill; applies only to that position.

entry._minLiquidityUsd: 25000 until 2026-11-11; lowered to 10000 (user choice): in the 1-72h pool, tokens rejected only for liquidity under $25k crashed 2% of the time (tracker, Oct 28 - Nov 4).
entry._crash: Crash filters added 2026-10-28 (user choice, starting values): no buy if sells beat buys in the last 5 min (when at least minTxnsM5 trades), liquidity under minLiqToMcapPct of market cap, or, compared with an earlier holder reading 10 min to 3h old, holders falling, the developer's share down by maxDevDropPts or more, or the top-10 share down by maxTop10DropPts or more.
entry._minBuySellRatioM5: 1 from 2026-10-28; 0 (off) since 2026-11-11 (user choice): in the 1-72h pool it blocked more winners than crashes (18% hit vs 5% crash, tracker Oct 28 - Nov 4).

_compounderV1: Rules used until 2026-10-10 (momentum entry, stops, +10% target). Kept for the October run record and src/compounder-replay.js.
